identity.title: Confirm recipe-step removal and block it during execution

origin.summary: The current Workbench removes the selected authored step immediately, including orphaned teaching selections, and its command remains available while validation or a selected Preview can be running.

state.current_summary: Recipe-step removal now requires impact-aware confirmation, defaults to cancellation, removes only the confirmed stable step and true orphan selections, and fails closed during active execution; focused, build, UI, R0, documentation, and structure gates pass.

claims.text: Executing RemoveSelectedStepCommand immediately removes the selected recipe step and orphaned teaching selections without confirmation, and the command predicate checks only whether a step is selected.

problem.impact: An operator can lose authored recipe structure or selection geometry with one click, including while an execution path is active, and there is no general Undo contract to recover it.

criteria.text: The remove command requests confirmation and does not mutate the recipe until the operator explicitly confirms; cancellation preserves steps, selections, selection, and dirty state.
The confirmation identifies the selected step and orphan-selection impact, and confirmation removes exactly that step plus only selections no remaining step uses.
Step removal is unavailable and fails closed while the selected Preview or validation set is running; the safety workflow never invokes Preview, Publish, Run, or validation.
Focused regression, Debug/Release builds, code-structure checks, current-build Wide/Compact confirmation UI evidence, refreshed fixed R0 inputs, and documentation checks pass.

context.summary: Owns recipe-step mutation policy and command state.

artifacts.summary: Current-build before/after screenshots, screenshot-quality reports, focused verification, build logs, and R0 validation output.

evidence.observation: At commit cb356fe, RemoveSelectedStepCommand checks only for a selected step and calls RemoveSelectedStep directly; that method removes the step and orphaned selections immediately. Fresh Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 application baselines passed capture-quality checks on the dynamic leftmost monitor.

Recipe Manager + WPG verification passed 40/40. The remove command emitted the selected stable step and one orphan-selection impact without changing steps, selections, selection, dirty state, or Run Log; command and confirmed mutation failed closed while validation was active; confirmation then removed exactly the selected step and its true orphan with one Teach log and no Preview/Publish/Run evidence.

Fresh current-Release Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 English and Korean confirmation captures identify Thickness and one orphaned Thickness Reference Surface ROI; normal and held Remove pointer-down images are distinct and all quality reports accept the captures. Dynamic leftmost DISPLAY2 bounds were [-1920,365,1920,1080]; actual Wide [-1920,365,1920,1040] and Compact [-1920,365,1280,760] windows were fully inside the selected monitor after physical-pixel to WPF-DIP placement correction.

evidence.kind: build, affected-product, R0, and documentation verification
evidence.observation: Final Debug and Release solution builds completed with zero warnings and errors; Shell command-line 35/35, docking 82/82, Tool Recipe teaching 35/35, Validation Set 84/84, and structure 29/29 passed. Refreshed nine-input Wide and Compact R0 ValidateOnly passed without launching the application; 26 changed-document local links, Proofline v2 validation, and git diff --check passed.

events.summary: Registered the confirmed destructive-mutation gap and began the bounded safety slice after capturing current-build baselines.

Added impact-aware localized confirmation, stable-ID and active-execution guards, exact orphan-selection cleanup, CI-routed regression coverage, scaled-monitor placement correction, current-build UI evidence, and refreshed fixed R0 inputs.
